mutant.description: The before-state was established by a predicate that can actually discriminate, after noticing one that could not. The TF resource name is market_update_gateway_put but the LIVE policy name is gateway-market-update-put-policy, so get-role-policy on the resource name returns NoSuchEntity even AFTER a successful apply -- it would have read as 'absent' on both sides and proved nothing. The before-state was therefore taken as a name census over the role's inline policies: 0 of 22 matched 'market', with 'advi' matching 1 as a positive control that the listing can see a policy that does exist. Separately, each plan's exit code was captured to its own .rc file rather than read off its summary line, because at OG-ap-7 step 5b this seat measured an INCOMPLETE plan printing exactly 1/0/0 while exiting rc=1.
mutant.expected: The role's inline count moves 22 -> 23; a name census for 'market' moves 0 -> 1; the live statement reads exactly one action on exactly one prefix; and the re-plan falls to 0/0/0 at rc=0.
